text: なみのりでは　しまを　いきき　できない　ながれが　はやすぎる　からな！

structure.jp: しまを　いきき　できない
structure.en: you can't go between the islands

structure.jp: ながれが　はやすぎる　からな！
structure.en: because the current is too fast!

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells what you use to do something. With は added it sets up a contrast: by this way, at least, no. なみのりでは = 'with Surf (you can't)'.

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる stuck onto a describing word means 'too much'. はやすぎる = 'is too fast'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives the reason for what was just said. はやすぎる　から = 'because it's too fast'.
